# IntProgress { #anylumino.IntProgress }

```python
IntProgress(
    value=0,
    min=0,
    max=100,
    description='',
    bar_style='',
    orientation='horizontal',
    layout=None,
    style=None,
)
```

Integer progress bar control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                                                     | Default    |
|-------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `0` |
| min | optional | Minimum numeric, date, or time value. | `0` |
| max | optional | Maximum numeric, date, or time value. | `100` |
| description | optional | Label shown next to the control. | `''` |
| bar_style | optional | Progress-bar style name such as ``'success'`` or ``'warning'``. | `''` |
| orientation | optional | ``'horizontal'`` or ``'vertical'``. | `'horizontal'` |
| layout | optional | ipywidgets ``Layout`` object for CSS sizing and spacing. | `None` |
| style | optional | ipywidgets style object or style dictionary. | `None` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [bar_style](#anylumino.IntProgress.bar_style) | Use a predefined styling for the progress bar. |
| [orientation](#anylumino.IntProgress.orientation) | Vertical or horizontal. |
| [style](#anylumino.IntProgress.style) | An instance trait which coerces a dict to an instance. |
